support: :rotating_light: Heads up — customer escalation incoming. Multiple hosted API tenants reporting 504s and 5xx on generation endpoints starting ~2026-03-15T10:23Z. Symptoms: long tail latencies leading to timeouts. Example tenant: acme-platform (tenant_id: t-acme-09), request_id r-0a1b2c3d. Posting curl + response snippet below.

alice_eng: on it, dropping in. which route/model?

support: POST /v1/generate model=redwood-xl-4k, route=hosted-gen-us-west. curl: ```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"input":"<long chat...>", "max_tokens": 3000}'
```
response: 504 Gateway Timeout, body: "request timed out after 10s".

ben_oncall: quick metric check — continuous-batcher instance cont-batcher-3 queue_depth spiked to ~12200 (soft limit 10000) around 10:22:54Z. Dequeue rate dropped ~60% for ~6m. p95 ingress latency went 0.35s -> 3.2s, p99 up to 12.6s. Logs show repetitive: `dequeue loop wait > 500ms` and `batch assemble timeout`. Several requests dropped with 504/5xx as queue hit backpressure.

support: customer says one customer session sent a ~7k token multi-turn prompt (long prefix + history). They reported it happened right after the deploy yesterday (r2026-03-14-8) but haven't guaranteed causation.

eng-runtime: digging — deploy r2026-03-14-8 changed default batcher config: max_batch_tokens=8192 and max_wait_ms=100. With long sequences, batch sizes balloon and KV cache memory pressure increases, which slows dequeue pipeline. Batcher memory thrashing -> stall -> queue depth accumulates. Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert max_batch_tokens to 4096, 2) drop max_wait_ms to 25ms to favor latency, 3) enable prefix-cache fast-path to avoid re-assembling large batches.

alice_eng: can we roll back the batcher config immediately? impact on throughput acceptable for now.

infra-bot: rollback job queued by @alice_eng — rolling r2026-03-14-8 -> r2026-03-14-7 (config-only). ETA ~4m.

ben_oncall: after rollback (10:34Z) cont-batcher-3 queue_depth fell to ~3100, dequeue rate back to normal, p99 down to ~2.1s. No new 5xx observed for 12m. Marking as mitigated for now.

matthew_pm: noted — notifying acme-platform about mitigation and offering credits. Follow-ups: add per-tenant inflight request cap, enforce request token limit at gateway (reject >4096 tokens), and add an alert for sustained queue_depth > 80% for any single batcher.

eng-runtime: agree. I'll open a postmortem PR with timeline and action items (config gating for batcher changes, deploy-runbook checklist).

support: thanks — keeping incident channel open for customer comms, will escalate SLA if instability returns. :thumbsup:
